findings.subject: Moon Pyramid west/east obsidian debris contrast
findings.assertion: Carballo reports 22 kg obsidian from 8.1 m3 in 6:N5W1 (2.72 kg/m3) versus 1.7 kg from 13.6 m3 in 22:N5E1 (0.13 kg/m3); obsidian-to-sherd weight ratios 61.7% versus 5.9%. Assemblages were secondary/tertiary mixed refuse, not intact knapping floors.
findings.limit: Spanish translation uses 8.31 m3; visually resolve before publication.

findings.subject: Polished bone pressure-reduction implement, Moon Pyramid west
findings.assertion: A polished bone tip was excavated from Deposit 3, Trench 8 Unit R; Carballo describes this as the sole pressure tool within three analyzed deposits. Deposit 3 was mixed secondary lithic refuse, not intact manufacturing floor.
findings.limit: Tool-function interpretation rests on monograph; usewear not independently inspected.

findings.subject: Trapeze-and-ray roof fragment at Complex 6:N5W1
findings.assertion: A roof-adornment fragment recovered between Structures 6B and 6E retained red stucco and a trapeze-and-ray/Year Sign motif; a thicker stone variety is reported for the same complex.
findings.limit: Do not infer original in situ roof placement or fixed iconographic meaning.

enrichment.proposed: More than 4,400 flakes picked from a 1-litre Deposit 1 sediment sample, with thousands of smaller pieces; Deposit 3 yielded 39 and 19 flakes from two samples, supporting secondary-discard differentiation. Not directly comparable standardized rates.

evidence_quality_issues.issue: Miccaotli unit counts 50+52+64=166 but displayed total 168; rows total 536 while columns total 534.
Level IV phase entries sum 180 but displayed total 280; displayed column totals sum 780 vs phase-row sums 680.
English passage 8.1 m3 vs Spanish passage 8.31 m3; reported 2.72 kg/m3 corresponds to English 8.1 m3.
